column7: A double-bracket-wrapped IPv6 literal (host=[[::1]]) bypassed validateAdminDSNHost: SplitDSNHostList stripped once to [::1], net.LookupHost("[::1]") failed, and the validator silently skipped the check — registration succeeded despite naming a private/loopback host. FuzzDSNHostsCoverDriverHosts confirmed the oracle discrepancy (pgx stores [[::1]], validator saw [::1], after one-level stripBrackets both sides diverged). Fix: SplitDSNHostList bracket-strip is now a loop so [[::1]] reaches the validator as ::1; net.ParseIP("::1") succeeds, isPrivateIP blocks it. Oracle updated to match (stripBrackets also loop-strips). Red at origin/main (validateAdminDSNHost("host=[[::1]]") returns nil); green at HEAD (returns non-nil error).
